design_decision: Fixed the resolver directly (both lookups carry ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL) rather than adding an includeDeactivated parameter. The sole production caller (resolveRolesForActor) is used exclusively to resolve the ACTING actor's own roles for self-authority PDP decisions (claim/approve/pool visibility) — there is no display-of-a-deactivated-employee's-roles use case anywhere in the codebase for this DAO (unlike e.g. pdp-explain.ts:loadSubjectGrants, which stays untouched in the T-0662 allowlist as a legitimate DISPLAY path). Adding a parameter with zero callers that would set it to true is needless surface.
